description: Public projection of the design-asset registry. A locked design asset is one of which exactly one edition may exist across the ecosystem; the enforcing gate derives its constants from this declaration rather than restating them in its own source.

assets.lock_rationale: The KYE cypress is the Map of KYE™ tree — the single visual identity of the protocol's shape. Two surfaces render it today and more will; a second edition anywhere would mean the protocol depicts itself differently depending on which page you land on.
